package.name: ds10_relay
package.description: Three-hop request/reply relay over the DS10 transparent link. The relay role sends a request to slave 1, matches the reply by an in-payload transaction header, then forwards that reply verbatim to slave 2; the responder role echoes whatever it receives back to the master. Sits on top of ds10_driver topics and adds no framing of its own beyond the transaction header.
